ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio approximately 65:35 between high-intensity (yellowish-white) regions and low-intensity (black/grey) perimeters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant light-intensity field (yellow-white) occupies the central and medial lobe regions, bounded by a thick dark-intensity (black) perimeter along the trailing edge and tips. Dark linear streaks intersect the light regions diagonally.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 65-70 degrees and significant depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) concentrated on the right lobe tip and distal edge. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-frequency, smoother serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a linear-to-concave sweep trajectory; the right lobe distal edge exhibits a broad, rounded convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular pixel formations (barnacle colonization) localized on the right lobe tip and the distal margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of parallel, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the light-pigmented ventral surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on both distal tips; significant rake marks across the light-pigmented regions of the ventral fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-cream hue across the high-intensity regions, deviating from standard white pigmentation.
